pilot_1.name: known-D standard + B-off/blank + object-plane ruler + held-out windows
pilot_1.design: r(t),orientation(t) with independent scale/timebase -> Eref+Escat -> intensity exposure average -> per-pixel spatial average -> frozen-sampling complex DFT; compare against held-out experimental windows
pilot_1.uncertainties: amplitude/phase/background/model and measurement budgets recorded before estimation; P0 convergence assessed on the actual call path

pilot_2.name: second physics condition (B-driven constrained trajectory) for model comparison
pilot_2.design: constrained dynamics from measured B(t)/gradient/sync -> trajectory -> same optical chain as pilot 1; independent held-out windows
